title: Implement stt-aldea extractor plugin for Aldea STT API
description: Part of Biblicus-shs (Aldea STT epic). New extractor stt-aldea in src/biblicus/extractors/aldea_stt.py. Use direct REST with httpx: POST https://api.aldea.ai/v1/listen, Authorization Bearer, body raw audio; parse results.channels[0].alternatives[0].transcript. Optional extra biblicus[aldea] = httpx. Config: language, diarization, timestamps. validate_config: require optional dep and resolve_aldea_api_key(). Register in extractors/__init__.py. Add aldea = [httpx>=0.24] in pyproject.toml.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter
